response.original_title: FAQS@2026~How do I add a passenger on a MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise reservation 1-866-829-1280, you must call MSC Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1-866-829-1280, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a passenger to an MSC Cruise online 1-866-829-1280, so you must contact MSC customer service or your travel agent directly by phone 1-866-829-1280. To add a guest to an existing MSC Cruise booking 1-866-829-1280, you must call customer service directly or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.
